{{Quote|I'm Morley. I could help you. We've got everything here. I can get you what you want. For the right amount of course.|Morley to [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]|<ref name=":0" />}}
'''Morley''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Anacondan/Legends|Anacondan]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] who lived on [[Lotho Minor/Legends|Lotho Minor]] and was a servant to [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].

==Biography==

===Early life===
Morley was a male [[Anacondan/Legends|Anacondan]] who lived<ref name="ency" /> during the last years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref> eking out a life<ref name="ency" /> on the junk [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lotho Minor/Legends|Lotho Minor]]<ref name=":0" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>
[[File:DarthScorpionKing-SWE.png|thumb|250x250px|Morley became the benefactor of [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] for over a decade.]]
Sometime after the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]<ref name=":2">{{Film|I}}</ref> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Morley encountered the ex [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]],<ref name=":3">''[[The Clone Wars: The Sith Hunters]]''</ref> left without legs after his duel with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]<ref name=":2" /> and dumped on [[Lotho Minor/Legends|Lotho Minor]].<ref name=":0" /> He was screaming and slithering away in fright from one of Lotho Minor's gigantic machines, the [[Fire-breather/Legends|Fire-breather]], when Maul threw his [[Darth Maul's double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] with the [[The Force/Legends|Force]] directly at the Fire-breather's head, piercing it through. The machine instantly fell to the ground, the fire from its mouth extinguished. As Maul blacked out, Morley wrapped the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] in his coils and brought him into the caves of the planet, which would eventually become his sanctuary.<ref name=":3" />

Morley pledged loyalty to Maul to survive,<ref name="ency" /> promising to lure unwitting prey into Maul's hungry clutches,<ref name=":0" /> as he had used the Force to acquire a six-legged arachnid-like [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] apparatus to replace his lost lower body.<ref name=":3" /> Maul aided in obtaining shelter and sustenance only by Morley.<ref name=":4" />

==="Helping" Savage Opress===
[[File:MorleyAndOpress-Brothers.png|thumb|left|250px|Morley and Savage Opress]]
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="FF-2014 24: Maul">{{FactFile2014|24|MAU 1-2|Darth Maul's Cybernetic Legs}}</ref> after [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] arrived on [[Lotho Minor/Legends|Lotho Minor]] in search of his brother, Morley presented himself and said that he would help him navigate his way to find him for a price, which changed to free when Savage choked Morley. After a brief conversation, Opress said his brother looked like him. Morley lied, claiming he had not seen him, and then followed up by mentioning an aggressive man with horns, which he claimed was a myth. Later, they ran through a field of [[Fire-breather/Legends|Fire-breathers]] and a brief battle with [[Junker/Legends|Junkers]], even saving Opress from a Junker's shot. After this, they arrived at a hut, in an attempt to escape the acid rain that frequently occurred on Lotho Minor.<ref name=":0" />

===Death===
[[File:SavageChokesMorley-Brothers.png|thumb|250x250px|Opress chokes to death Morley.]]
In the hut, which Savage had thought would be where his brother had been living, he found only Junker corpses. Then, Morley betrayed him and threw him down the chute, and cackled as he bragged that he would get the leftovers of the presumably soon to be dead Savage Opress. Instead Savage Opress found his brother, now a cyborg in terrible-condition. When Morley came down the chute for his leftovers of supposed dead Opress, he was shocked to see that he was still alive. Savage blamed his brother's condition on him and choked him to [[Death/Legends|death]]. He then threw Morley's corpse into a fire out of anger.<ref name=":0" />

==Personality and traits==
A peculiar<ref name=":1" /> [[Anacondan/Legends|Anacondan]] with a size of 4.7 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long, Morley believed in self-preservation. He needed cunning to survive on the junk planet of [[Lotho Minor/Legends|Lotho Minor]], doing anything to survive,<ref name="ency">{{SWE|characters|morley|Morley}}</ref> including cutting a deal with a [[Savage Opress/Legends|devilish outcast]].<ref name=":0" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Morley_Head_Concept_Art.png|thumb|250x250px|Concept art on Morley.]]
Morley first appeared in "[[Brothers (episode)|Brothers]]",<ref name=":0">{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}}</ref> the twenty-first episode of [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|season four]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, and first aired on [[March 9]] [[2012]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref> He was voiced by [[Ben Diskin]].<ref name=":0" /> In the original script Morley was killed by Maul and not by Opress. Morley's mouth and animation design was a throwback to a time when creature effects were made with hand puppets.<ref name=":1">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep421|text="Brothers" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>

Morley was inspired by the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Serpents_in_the_Bible#Eden serpent of Eden], a trickster who managed to tempt [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eve Eve] to taste the forbidden fruit in the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Garden_of_Eden garden of Eden]. Morley claimed that Maul was just a local legend, but in fact he was leading Opress towards his master’s lair.<ref name="Back from the Drawing Board">{{SW|url=news/drawing-from-the-imagination-mythological-creatures-in-star-wars-part-1|text=Drawing from the Imagination: Mythological Creatures in ''Star Wars'', Part 1|int=Back from the Drawing Board|nolive=1}}</ref>

===Conflicting death===
In ''[[The Wrath of Darth Maul]]'', Morley's role and death are presented much differently than in ''The Clone Wars'' television series. In this story, Morley does not double-cross Savage and leads him into the cave where Maul resides. Maul regards Morley as a scavenger and that he should have kept his distance from him, then leaps down on top of him from the ceiling of the cavern and crushes him to death with his mechanical apparatus.<ref name=":4">''[[The Wrath of Darth Maul]]''</ref> According to the trivia gallery for ''Brothers'', this was actually originally scripted in the episode,<ref name=":1" /> but was changed to Opress killing him in revenge.<ref name=":0" />
